item.title: Iran sees growth in iron and steel exports for 9M2025
item.description: Iran’s iron and steel exports have experienced significant growth in both value and volume over the first nine months of the current Iranian year. This includes a notable rise in crude steel and steel product exports compared to the previous year. The country’s overall steel export performance has shown a strong upward trend.
